quest.legacyoftheforce.echo.title: An Echo in the Stone
quest.legacyoftheforce.echo.origin: An unnamed traveller's archive — 'Beneath the snow, a light awaits those who listen. Take what you need; let others choose their path.'
quest.legacyoftheforce.echo.clue: To Ilum: craft coordinates with a compass, paper, an amethyst shard and lapis. At a terminal (IGI/CRC/III: iron, glass, copper, redstone), decode them; it displays the fare. Bring the second terminal for your return. On Ilum, find a stone-brick mine entrance: its stairs descend beneath blue ice. Bring an iron pickaxe; each crystal keeps its identity. Duels are optional. Install it at a saber workshop to continue your adventure.

quest.legacyoftheforce.echo.collect: Acquire an identified Ilum crystal; one already installed in your saber also counts. No item consumption or alignment reward.

notes.legacyoftheforce.tatooine.0: Look for mine entrances in sandstone plateaus. Their stairs descend to a rare yellow formation.
notes.legacyoftheforce.tatooine.1: The Wandering Knight counters a guarded hit. Moving or breaking his sandstone cover opens his defense.
notes.legacyoftheforce.tatooine.2: The Exile signals gusts and storms. Put a pillar between yourself and danger; moving his stones breaks his focus.
notes.legacyoftheforce.tatooine.3: The sand ring leaves a safe center and can be jumped. Head coverings, shade or water limit sun fatigue.
notes.legacyoftheforce.tatooine.4: Silica is used in racing engines: more thrust, less lift. Wrecks can hold an Endor chart.
boss.legacyoftheforce.step_inside: Step inside the arena before starting the trial.
notes.legacyoftheforce.endor.0: Look for old stairs beneath the roots: a green formation may lie in the grotto. Amber wood yields resin.
notes.legacyoftheforce.endor.1: Climb lookout ladders for supplies and occasional Mustafar charts.
notes.legacyoftheforce.endor.2: Wooden anchors sustain the Keeper’s guard and healing. Move them with the Force or break them; jump to avoid waves and roots.
notes.legacyoftheforce.endor.3: The Assassin uses weightless decoys. A hit dispels them; Force perception reveals the real foe.
notes.legacyoftheforce.endor.4: The forest chassis provides more stability at a higher mass. Clearings make speeder travel easier.
travel.legacyoftheforce.volcanic_warning: Nearby lava is wearing you down: seek shelter or fire protection.
notes.legacyoftheforce.mustafar.0: Refinery chests hold supplies and slag. Crystal vaults have stone-lined stairs above the flows.
notes.legacyoftheforce.mustafar.1: Fire resistance helps against lava and embers. Water evaporates here; walls shield nearby heat, but a head covering alone does not.
notes.legacyoftheforce.mustafar.2: Break or move the Protector’s stones to open his guard. His seals heat the floor: step onto platforms or leave the mark.
notes.legacyoftheforce.mustafar.3: Ember bolts are real projectiles that can be countered with the Force. Pools and eruptions are signaled; cover remains useful.
notes.legacyoftheforce.mustafar.4: The high-power engine lifts more but is heavy. Encounters may yield a crossguard saber plan and Dagobah coordinates.
boss.legacyoftheforce.dread_warning: A brief dread weakens you. Move away or seek cover.
notes.legacyoftheforce.dagobah.0: Small rises shelter stairs to sealed grottos. Cyan kyber and essence roots are rare there.
notes.legacyoftheforce.dagobah.1: Mud slows bare feet: boots help. The Dagobah stabilizer adds lift at the cost of mass and stability.
notes.legacyoftheforce.dagobah.2: The Hermit’s stones really move. Shift or break them to open his defense; a Force impulse can prompt a signaled counter.
notes.legacyoftheforce.dagobah.3: Sense reveals the real foe and dispels doubles. A struck decoy disappears without XP or alignment changes.
notes.legacyoftheforce.dagobah.4: The Master mixes real and harmless bolts. Perception, movement and cover matter; essence also helps focus a bonded crystal.
travel.legacyoftheforce.rune_clue_0: The pillar watches; the sun rises, then the moon answers.
travel.legacyoftheforce.rune_clue_1: The moon guides toward the pillar; at dawn the sun lights it.
travel.legacyoftheforce.rune_clue_2: The sun yields to the moon; its light reveals the pillar.
travel.legacyoftheforce.rune_wrong: The seal falls silent. Read the clue and try again.
travel.legacyoftheforce.rune_open: The seal is stable: the crystal can be mined.
travel.legacyoftheforce.rune_invalid: The seal source is missing or inconsistent.
travel.legacyoftheforce.rune_pending: Unlock retained, mining suspended. Touch the console to retry.
notes.legacyoftheforce.jedha.0: The white cliff bands are calcite. Chambers and archives lie on traversable plateaus.
notes.legacyoftheforce.jedha.1: Touch a console to read its inscription. Its symbols are Sun, Moon and Pillar; follow their order in the words.
notes.legacyoftheforce.jedha.2: A mistake resets the sequence. Travelers may cooperate, but the crystal source is shared.
notes.legacyoftheforce.jedha.3: Once the seal is stable, mine the purple crystal with an iron pickaxe. The mechanism does not create a new deposit.
notes.legacyoftheforce.jedha.4: Relic dust helps purify corrupted crystals. Jedha circuits store more energy per module but are heavier.
notes.legacyoftheforce.ilum.0: Access towers lead to rare caverns. Blue sources are surrounded by dense ice.
notes.legacyoftheforce.ilum.1: Frost metal veins lie in the floors of new caverns. An iron pickaxe yields fragments to smelt.
notes.legacyoftheforce.ilum.2: Cryogenic thrusters favor lift, with more mass and less thrust than standard vector thrusters.
notes.legacyoftheforce.ilum.3: Guardian and Frost Lord altars start a challenge. Protective ice and projectiles are real temporary objects.
notes.legacyoftheforce.ilum.4: Eligible victories yield metal, coordinates and sometimes blue kyber. Rewards have personal and arena cooldowns.

saber.legacyoftheforce.form_help_twin: Two distinct awakened, ignited single sabers. High fatigue, shared combo; /lotf saber offhand strikes with the second blade.
